description: C# two-project ASP.NET Core solution for the Roslyn taint engine (plan 6B-C#): a controller (Shop.Web, multi-targeting net8.0 and net10.0) hands a query parameter to a service in a class library (Shop.Core) that builds an SqlCommand from it; a second action builds an SqlCommand in the controller itself

notes.src/Shop.Core/CustomerLookup.cs:15: the sink of the cross-project flow: CustomersController.Count(city) -> CustomerLookup.CountByCity(city) -> text -> new SqlCommand(text, connection). Only the Roslyn taint engine (qualor dotnet end, pack with dotnetEngine) finds it: the OpenGrep rule follows taint inside one file. Without the engine the harness reports this finding as missing
notes.src/Shop.Web/Controllers/CustomersContro: the in-file flow (Exists(name)), found by the engine and, when it falls back (QUALOR_TAINT_MEMORY_LIMIT=1, see cli/src/dotnet/real.test.ts), by the OpenGrep rule. Shop.Web builds for net8.0 and net10.0: one finding, not two
notes.src/Shop.Core/CustomerLookup.cs:25: CountByCountry binds a parameter: no finding
